name: How long does insulation installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does insulation installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an insulation installation project depends on the scope of work. Insulating an attic in an existing home might take one to two days. A whole-house insulation upgrade, especially in new construction or during a major remodel, could take several days to a week. Factors like the type of insulation, accessibility of the spaces, and whether old insulation needs removal will influence the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, from one to two days for an attic to several days for a whole-house upgrade, depending on scope and type.
